confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Colombian and Cartagena tourist pricing, adjusted for July peak season; no live menus, booking pages, or current listings were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain given the wide rate spread by neighborhood, category, and season. Cocktail and wine_glass are inferred from the local beer price level and typical tourist-bar markups because direct knowledge is weaker. Peso volatility and 2026 inflation could shift the USD figures.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single exact comparable city was used. The basis is the price level of Colombian Caribbean and other high-demand Colombian visitor hubs (for example Santa Marta and Medellin's tourist districts), adjusted upward for Cartagena's historic-center tourism premium and July high-season demand.
